rules.question: Which settings pick a stored result: chart mode, SP cap and lens?
rules.owner: Settings::record_key in src/app/config.cpp (store::ResultSettings is the type)
rules.decision: concept audit M12 (code-only, D114 fix wave, task H1)
rules.note: A result is filed under (chart, chart mode, SP cap, lens); store::ResultSettings is that identity without the chart and RecordKey embeds it. This row flags a caller re-assembling the three parts from Settings. It cannot see the parts passed as already-named variables, so the type (lookups take a ResultSettings) is the real guard.
